title: Deepgram API key (unprefixed): one-property twin (context)
summary: 12 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY renamed DEEPGRAM_PROJECT_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte, context: DG_API_KEY renamed DG_REQUEST_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and context: the Deepgram createClient factory replaced by an unrelated one, so no Deepgram name remains; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and 5 more. Twin of "Deepgram API key (unprefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of deepgram-api-key-compose-env: context: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY renamed DEEPGRAM_PROJECT_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
